summary: A blue-and-red shoaling fish native to the upper Orinoco and Negro river systems. The red lower flank extends much farther forward than in a neon tetra; it is kept in planted and blackwater aquariums.
nativeRange: Upper Orinoco and Negro river basins in South America.

features: Bright blue stripe across the side.
Vivid red covers the lower flank almost from head to tail.
Small body, reaching about 5 cm in the cited aquarium guide.

lookAlikes.difference: The neon tetra has a shorter red band limited mostly to its rear half.

habitat.diet: Small worms and crustaceans; aquarium fish take varied small prepared and frozen foods.
